title: ReferenceDescriptor v0.1
description: Domain-neutral structured reference descriptor. Carries identity and display info only — never canonical business state.

uri.description: Identity. Canonical form is dsh-resource://<kind>/<id>; the dsh-ref: alias is normalized into it, with the original alias preserved at metadata.alias.

namespace.description: Reserved. Single value in v0.1; parse layer fills it, host layer must not require it.

label.description: Display label from the wire link text.

kind.description: Open vocabulary. The parser does not whitelist kinds (domain-neutral).

snapshot.description: Message-time immutable view data (optional). Never treated as canonical state.

metadata.description: Provenance and extensions. Known key: alias (original dsh-ref: uri).
